pages.text: Use air below a dimension's minimum build height or at/above its maximum build height. The reusable bottle has 1024 durability; disposable bottles stack to 16. Output enters inventory first, then personal storage.

Primordial Qi shrinks a living entity to zero over 10 ticks (0.5 seconds) and discards it without a kill. A matching spawn egg is discovered from the global item registry. Config can block entity ids; tribulation disables use; Ender Dragon conversion completes the dragon fight.
Ancient Jade can also appear in every vanilla suspicious sand or suspicious gravel archaeology table at a configurable chance, 5% by default.
